WITH site_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(m.facetregistry) AS mesh_count
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanmesh AS m
    ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios
  GROUP BY insurstat
)
SELECT
  sr.insurstat,
  AVG(sr.avg_ratio) AS above_average_sites_avg_ratio,
  COUNT(*) AS above_average_site_count,
  AVG(sr.avg_ratio - sa.status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_over_status_average
FROM site_ratios AS sr
JOIN status_averages AS sa
  ON sa.insurstat = sr.insurstat
WHERE sr.avg_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio
GROUP BY sr.insurstat

assumptions.assumption: A site's mesh count includes all matching mesh records, including records whose ratio is missing; missing ratios are excluded from its average, and a zero geometric accuracy is treated as a missing ratio to avoid division by zero.
